hypothesis: The integration of machine learning (ML) and language models can significantly enhance climate adaptation strategies by providing more accurate and localized predictions of climate impacts, such as temperature and flood risks, which can inform proactive adaptation measures [tackling-climate-ml:40]. ML models, when combined with existing climate models, can improve the understanding of how weather shocks impact economic outcomes, particularly in agriculture, by leveraging high-dimensional data to assess adaptation potential [climate-adaptation-ml:0]. Additionally, the use of language models in educational contexts can optimize the dissemination of climate adaptation knowledge, enabling educators to tailor information to specific regional needs and improve the effectiveness of adaptation strategies [llm-education-survey:14].
